Contract:
Rendered by the CALLING step's final step, after its artifact is written and verified. Shape:
1. One ✅ line — what was produced and what was checked (`✅ Спека записана · язык проверен · диаграмм`). 2. `**Что дальше?**` + one `AskUserQuestion` call. Options (2–4) come from the caller's own candidate table; the recommended option first with «(рекомендую)»; CHAINED options are first-class («декомпозиция + критик следом», «scaffold + сразу execute») — one pick launches the whole chain, the agent runs it without stopping between links unless a link fails. Always include «Закончить сессию» last. 3. On pick: invoke the corresponding skill(s) / directive flow(s) directly — never answer with «запусти /sdd-X сам».
